dialogues.speaker: Kumari
dialogues.text: I would like to become a dancer as good as Nilou when I grow up!

dialogues.speaker: Kumari
dialogues.text: Why won't Dad let me learn to dance...?

dialogues.speaker: Kumari
dialogues.text: He said dancing was looked down upon in Sumeru. To live a better life, I should go to school instead of learning how to dance.

dialogues.speaker: Kumari
dialogues.text: B—But, Nilou is so good at dancing, and everybody loves her so much...

dialogues.speaker: Kumari
dialogues.text: Is success at school more desirable than being a good dancer?

dialogues.speaker: Kumari
dialogues.text: I love Nilou! She's so gorgeous, and her voice is so melodious, and her dance is stunning...

dialogues.speaker: Kumari
dialogues.text: Every time I see Nilou, she would smile and let me touch the jewelry on her head.

dialogues.speaker: Kumari
dialogues.text: The Sabzeruz Festival is my favorite holiday. I can get candies from the Knight of Flowers, and I can watch Nilou's dance that day!

dialogues.speaker: Kumari
dialogues.text: Then be sure not to miss it! Hope you'll have a chance to enjoy Nilou's dance and try the best sweets!
